**Removing the Science update causes the largest drop: −13.3 points on MMLU (Science).** This comes from Table 7 in Appendix E.2 (p. 25).

In the 1.5B PPO block, the full Naive Parallel-RL model scores 48.9 on MMLU (p. 25). Without the Science update, MMLU falls to 35.6, a change of −13.3 (p. 25). This is the largest target-task drop in the PPO setting. The other removals give:

| Removed update | Drop on its own task |
|---|---|
| Science | −13.3 (MMLU) |
| Logic | −6.0 (KK) |
| Code | −4.0 (LiveCodeBench) |
| Math | −2.0 (MATH500) |

All values are from p. 25.

Removing the Science update also raised the other tasks: MATH500 +1.0, KK +8.0, LCB +1.6. This gives a Δ_Others of +3.5 (p. 25).
